description: Development-scale honest run through export + bridge verification (not a substitute for full Pipeline.py finalize unless extended).
hardline_semantics: In this repository, hardline means instruction-mandatory and contract-validated, not hook-enforced. Agents must treat this file and repo rules as binding even when no pre-commit, MCP, or CI gate enforces them.

artifact_requirements_dev_green.note: partial_progress is valid for dev-green when all dev_green_required_stages are passed (e.g. --stop-after export_panel).

forbidden_shortcuts: Weakening tests, assertions, or verifiers to force green.
Bypassing schema, PIT, compat, or bridge guards in code paths used for canonical claims.
Editing this contract or e2e_definition.md to match broken behavior instead of fixing behavior.
Treating pre-existing artifacts as proof of tonight's run without a fresh run_status / stage log correlation.
Stubbing or no-oping canonical_market_data, verify_market_data, or export_panel while claiming DEV_E2E_GREEN.
Using export-latest --skip-universe-filter for canonical DEV_E2E_GREEN without explicit out-of-band approval and without documenting universe_filter_applied=false.
